title: Bought 'an Ironbound hauberk' for 10 gold; no wear/equip action ever appeared afterward, and the Combat line kept reading 'armor+6 (mail shirt)' for the rest of the game, so there is no way to tell whether the purchase did anything.
where: The Ironbound Chapterhouse, Cinderhall / 'buy an Ironbound hauberk'
